note: Uses the atlas uncertainty group. Edges use atlas nodes probability and eigen.

description.zh: 下一步只取决于当前状态；n 步转移是转移矩阵的 n 次幂；正常的链收敛到稳态 π（πP = π），速度由第二特征值 |λ₂| 决定；有吸收态的链（赌徒）没有中间稳态。有限状态、一阶、时间齐次模型。
description.en: The next step depends only on the current state; n-step transitions are the n-th power of the transition matrix; an ordinary chain converges to a steady state π (πP = π) at a speed set by the second eigenvalue |λ₂|; a chain with absorbing states (the gambler) has no middle steady state. A finite, first-order, time-homogeneous model.

reason.zh: 转移概率就是“已知今天、明天各状态的条件概率”，把它们一步步相乘相加就得到多步转移。
reason.en: A transition probability is the conditional probability of each state tomorrow given today, and multiplying and adding them step by step gives multi-step transitions.

reason.zh: 转移矩阵的稳态是特征值 1 对应的左特征向量，其余特征值的大小 |λ₂| 决定与稳态的距离按 |λ₂|ⁿ 衰减。
reason.en: The steady state is the left eigenvector for eigenvalue 1, and the size of the next eigenvalue |λ₂| makes the distance to it decay like |λ₂|ⁿ.

title.zh: 为什么随机游走会有稳定的长期比例？
title.en: Why does a random walk have a stable long-run share?
